ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is triggered if the sub Type is EPP Technical Error or EPP Early closure, the maker result is mandatory.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: TEXT(Type) = 'Credit Card Services' && (TEXT(Sub_Type__c) = 'EPP Early Closure' || TEXT(Sub_Type__c) = 'EPP Technical Error') && TEXT(cc_Maker__c)='' && ISCHANGED(cc_Checker_Result__c) && (NOT(TEXT(cc_Checker_Result__c)='Return to Maker'))
